caption: The drawing depicts a fragment of a wall containing a small recessed panel with a design. The design features a cross with rounded ends, centrally positioned within a rectangular frame. The background inside the frame is colored in shades of red, and the cross itself is white or light gray with a dark outline. The surrounding stone or plaster of the wall is illustrated with light gray and beige tones, giving a textured appearance. Below the panel and cross, there is a series of vertical grooves or fluting in the stone, suggesting architectural detailing. Beneath the drawing of the wall fragment, there is a horizontal scale bar labeled with measurements ("6”" and "2 Ft"), and the artist's signature "Geoffrey Holt" appears in the bottom right corner. The composition is placed on a plain off-white background, with most of the details concentrated in the center of the page.
title: Cross over Main Entrance to Mission
